metaDescription: Help keep free public data about Indian districts online. Give any amount once, or monthly from {amount}. Your name can appear on the district, state or all-India pages you support.
title: Support ForThePeople.in
lead: Your support pays for the servers and data feeds that keep every district page free for everyone. There are no ads and no paywall.
tiersTitle: Choose how you want to help
noteMonthly: Paid automatically each month. Cancel any time.
tier_custom_desc: Give once. Your name goes on the supporters list if you want it there.
tier_district_desc: Your name on the page of the district you choose.
tier_state_desc: Your name on every district page in the state you choose.
tier_patron_desc: Your name on every district page across India.
tier_founder_desc: Your name first, on every page of the site.
how1Body: Press the button on the plan you want. For a district or state plan, choose the place.
how2Body: Type your name the way you want it shown, or keep it hidden. Monthly plans also ask for a phone number, which UPI AutoPay or a bank mandate needs.
how3Body: Pay safely with UPI, card or net banking. Monthly plans renew every month, and you can cancel any time.
howNote: Payments are in Indian rupees. For any question about a payment, write to <link>support@forthepeople.in</link>.
leaderboardLink: See everyone who supports the site
moneyNote: Share of the running cost, as shared by the founder.
